query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: One of Hanoi's most iconic street food stalls specializing in Banh Mi [1.2.3]. This highly popular spot offers an extensive menu of crispy baguettes with classic pâté, pork, chicken, and highly-rated vegetarian options. Guests can sit on tiny plastic stools in a simple seating area across the road to enjoy their food.

places.title: Ta Hien Beer Street
places.text: A legendary walking street in Hanoi's Old Quarter that comes alive on weekend evenings. It is the ultimate hub for street dining, where locals and travelers sit on low plastic stools to enjoy cheap draught beer (Bia Hoi) alongside various Vietnamese street snacks, grilled skewers, and fried foods.

places.title: Bun Cha Ta Hanoi
places.text: A fantastic spot in the Old Quarter to try Bun Cha, one of Hanoi's most famous culinary specialties. This restaurant serves incredibly flavorful grilled pork patties and pork belly in a warm broth, served with rice noodles and a mountain of fresh herbs, as well as highly rated vegetarian variations.

places.title: Dong xuan market
places.text: Hanoi's largest indoor market is a bustling sensory experience. While the upper floors focus on wholesale clothing and goods, the alleyways and ground floors are packed with vibrant food stalls serving authentic local street food, including Cháo Sườn (rib rice porridge), Bún Chả, and sweet Chè desserts.
